_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Microcircuit Product Assurance Program Plan
summary: The Microcircuit Product Assurance Program Plan details the design procedures, manufacturing processes, inspection, and testing methods for microcircuits to demonstrate the manufacturer's understanding of a complete quality assurance program.
description_purpose: The purpose of the Microcircuit Product Assurance Program Plan is to detail the design procedures, manufacturing processes, inspection, and testing methods for microcircuits. It will serve to demonstrate the manufacturer's understanding of a complete quality assurance program.
application_interrelationship: This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: General.
preparation_instructions.content: For additional guidance, refer to MIL-M-38510, Appendix A. The plan must include all proprietary information necessary for the completeness and support of this plan.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The plan may be in the contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The plan shall contain the following:

children.title: Examples of design, material, equipment, visual standard and process instructions
Examples of design, material, and process change control documents
Examples of failure and defect analysis and feedback documents
Examples of corrective action and evaluation documents
Contractor's internal instructions for internal visual inspection
Examples of design and construction baseline
